anomalies.description: Two armed individuals engage in close-quarters physical struggle inside a dark, ruined building; one appears to be subduing or grappling the other near a barred gate.
A muzzle flash is briefly visible near the center of frame f2 (37.0s), consistent with a firearm discharge during the close combat; no sustained gunfire observed.
Two figures run across a war-torn urban street littered with debris and tents; however, no collective violence, clashes, or unrest is visually evident—only movement through a devastated area.
Two individuals engage in close physical combat in the street; one appears to tackle or grapple the other, with visible dynamic motion and contact across frames f0–f2.
A second instance of physical combat occurs: two figures are seen in close proximity with aggressive postures and movement suggesting grappling or striking, visible from f6 through f9.

In frames f12–f15, two armed individuals near a wrecked vehicle adopt firing stances; muzzle flash is not clearly visible, but one figure raises a weapon toward the left while the other appears to aim—consistent with active shooting, though visual proof of discharge is ambiguous.
